name: How do I choose between matte, eggshell, satin, and semi-gloss paint sheens?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between matte, eggshell, satin, and semi-gloss paint sheens?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right paint sheen depends on room traffic, moisture, and how flat your drywall is. Flat or matte finishes hide minor drywall imperfections well, making them ideal for ceilings and low-traffic bedrooms, but they are harder to wipe clean. Eggshell and satin provide a slight luster, resist scuffs, and wipe clean easily, making them standard choices for living rooms, hallways, and kids' rooms. Semi-gloss is moisture-resistant and durable, designed for baseboards, doors, trim, and bathrooms, but its reflective surface highlights surface dents and uneven seams. Balancing durability against surface appearance helps determine the best choice.
acceptedAnswer.description: Eggshell and satin work best for standard living areas, flat hides drywall flaws on ceilings, and moisture-resistant semi-gloss is ideal for trim, kitchens, and bathrooms.
